name: The Digit Sum of an Integer
description: Construct a program that calculates the sum of the digits of an integer.
code:
#Step 1: Assign initial values to the variables which we need for this program
num = 1234
total = 0
#Step 2: Sum up the digits of the integer 
while num > 0 :
    #Step 2.1: Get the last digit in the integer
    last_digit = num % 10
    #Step 2.2:?Add the last digit to the sum of digits so far
    total = total + last_digit
    #Step 2.3: Remove the last digit from the integer
    num = num // 10
    print("last digit:", last_digit, ", sum:", total, ", integer:", num)
print("The sum of the digits:", total)

1.content: #Step 1: Assign initial values to the variables which we need for this program

commentList: We need variable num to store the integer that we want to sum up its digits.
We need variable total to store the sum of the digits of the integer. We initialize it to 0.

4.content: #Step 2: Sum up the digits of the integer

commentList:
We need to process the digits of the integer from right to left and print them. Therefore, we need to use a loop structure. Since we don't know ahead of time how many times the loop will be repeated, we need to use a while loop. The condition in the while loop tests whether the body of the loop should be repeated, so it should test whether there are more digits left that we have not processed yet.

We could check whether the are more digits left by checking whether the variable num, which gets updated in the body of the loop, is greater than zero. If variable num is greater than zero, then it must have at least one digit, and in that case, the body of the do loop will be repeated again.

The body of the while loop is repeated as long as there are more digits left that we have not processed yet. The loop terminates when the loop condition evaluates to False, that is when we run out of digits to process.

6.content: #Step 2.1: Get the last digit in the integer

commentList: We need to extract the last digit in the 1's position of the integer. For example, if the integer is 1234, we want to extract the digit 4 that is in 1's position of the integer. We do this by calculating the remainder of the division of the integer by 10.

8.content: #Step 2.2:?Add the last digit to the sum of digits so far

commentList: We add the extracted digit to the variable total that stores the sum of the digits of the integer and store the result back into the variable total.

10.content: #Step 2.3: Remove the last digit from the integer

commentList: We truncate the extracted digit that we processed from the original integer by dividing the integer by 10. Note that we want to truncate the fractional part of the result, if there is any. Therefore, we need to use the floor division by using // operator. Therefore, this division will remove the digit that we processed (last_digit) and we can move on to the next digit.

12.content: print("last digit:", last_digit, ", sum:", total, ", integer:", num)
commentList:
Each time the body of the do loop is repeated, this statement prints to the default standard output stream the updated values of the variables that we use to find the sum of the digits in the integer.
The printed text shows the arguments of the print function separated by the default delimiter (i.e., single space character) and followed by the end-of-line character at the end.

13.content: print("The sum of the digits:", total)
commentList:
This statement prints to the default standard output stream the text "The sum of the digits:" and the value of variable total.
The printed text shows the arguments of the print function separated by the default delimiter (i.e., single space character) and followed by the end-of-line character at the end.
